title: SPRUCE Overview
description: Carbon, energy and water from AWS billing data enriched by SPRUCE, queried from S3 through Athena.

query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT billing_period FROM enriched ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Scope 2, operational (kg CO2e)
panels.description: Emissions from the electricity consumed. SPRUCE applies PUE, power supply efficiency and transmission losses when computing this, so dividing it by energy gives more than the grid intensity.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT round(sum(operational_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')

panels.title: Scope 3, embodied (kg CO2e)
panels.description: Emissions embodied in the hardware, amortised over the billed usage. Scope 1 is not estimated: nothing in billing data describes on-site fuel combustion.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT round(sum(embodied_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')

panels.title: Energy (kWh)
panels.description: IT energy only. The datacentre and grid overheads are applied to the emissions figures rather than to this one.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT round(sum(operational_energy_kwh), 1) AS kwh
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')

panels.title: Coverage of billed usage
panels.description: Share of usage charges SPRUCE could model. Published without this figure beside them, the totals above imply a completeness they do not have.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN operational_emissions_co2eq_g IS NOT NULL THEN billedcost ELSE 0 END)
             / nullif(sum(billedcost), 0), 2) AS pct
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')
  AND chargecategory LIKE '%Usage'

SELECT billing_period,
       round(sum(operational_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS scope_2_kg,
       round(sum(embodied_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS scope_3_kg
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')
GROUP BY billing_period
ORDER BY billing_period

SELECT servicename,
       round(sum(operational_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg_co2e,
       round(sum(operational_energy_kwh), 1) AS kwh,
       round(sum(billedcost), 2) AS cost
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')
  AND operational_emissions_co2eq_g IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY servicename
ORDER BY kg_co2e DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Regions
panels.description: Carbon intensity and PUE are energy-weighted, not averaged. A plain average over rows weights an hour of a small instance the same as a month of a large one, which is an 8% error on a typical CUR.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT region,
       round(sum(operational_energy_kwh), 1) AS kwh,
       round(sum(carbon_intensity * operational_energy_kwh)
             / nullif(sum(operational_energy_kwh), 0), 1) AS grid_g_per_kwh,
       round(sum(power_usage_effectiveness * operational_energy_kwh)
             / nullif(sum(operational_energy_kwh), 0), 3) AS pue,
       round(sum(operational_emissions_co2eq_g) / 1000.0, 1) AS kg_co2e,
       round(sum(coalesce(water_cooling_l, 0) + coalesce(water_electricity_production_l, 0)), 0) AS water_l
FROM enriched
WHERE billing_period IN (${billing_period:singlequote})
  AND (bill_billing_entity IS NULL OR bill_billing_entity = 'AWS')
  AND operational_emissions_co2eq_g IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY kwh DESC
